842	/// The one warm loop every warm in the harness is a policy over: step `bench` in warmup passes,
843	/// probe after each pass when a series is given, and stop when `done` says so.
844	///
845	/// - `done` is tested before each pass with the probe series so far and the number of passes
846	///   completed, so a fixed-count policy counts, a budget policy reads its own clock, and the
847	///   warm-until-stable policy grades the series' trailing window.
848	/// - Probing after the pass rather than before means the first probe already has a pass of warm
849	///   behind it.
850	/// - Returns each pass's per-step wall cost (ns): the sizing input. When a series is given the
851	///   vec is parallel to the probes this call appended, one cost per probe.
852	fn warm_loop<B: Bench>(
853	    bench: &mut B,
854	    pass: WarmPass,
855	    mut series: Option<WarmSeries<'_>>,
856	    mut done: impl FnMut(&[ProbeSummary], u64) -> bool,
857	) -> Vec<f64> {
858	    let mut costs: Vec<f64> = Vec::new();
859	    let mut passes: u64 = 0;
860	    loop {
861	        let view: &[ProbeSummary] = series.as_ref().map_or(&[], |ws| ws.probes.as_slice());
862	        if done(view, passes) {
863	            break;
864	        }
865	        let pass_start = std::time::Instant::now();
866	        let mut steps: u64 = 0;
867	        match pass {
868	            WarmPass::Seconds { s, chunk } => {
869	                while pass_start.elapsed().as_secs_f64() < s {
870	                    for _ in 0..chunk {
871	                        black_box(bench.step());
872	                    }
873	                    steps += chunk as u64;
874	                }
875	            }
876	            WarmPass::Adaptive {
877	                min_steps,
878	                min_s,
879	                deadline,
880	            } => {
881	                let mut chunk: u64 = 1;
882	                loop {
883	                    for _ in 0..chunk {
884	                        black_box(bench.step());
885	                    }
886	                    steps += chunk;
887	                    let now = std::time::Instant::now();
888	                    if now >= deadline {
889	                        break;
890	                    }
891	                    let elapsed_s = (now - pass_start).as_secs_f64();
892	                    if steps >= min_steps && elapsed_s >= min_s {
893	                        break;
894	                    }
895	                    // Still early in the pass: this bench is cheap, so widen the
896	                    // chunk to keep the check cost out of the measured pass.
897	                    if chunk < WARM_STEP_CHUNK_MAX && elapsed_s < min_s / 4.0 {
898	                        chunk *= 2;
899	                    }
900	                }
901	            }
902	        }
903	        if steps > 0 {
904	            costs.push(pass_start.elapsed().as_nanos() as f64 / steps as f64);
905	        }
906	        if let Some(ws) = series.as_mut() {
907	            ws.probes.push(ws.prober.probe(ws.origin));
908	        }
909	        passes += 1;
910	    }

912	}

929	/// The warm exit window: the smallest trailing slice of the probe series holding at least
930	/// [`WARM_WINDOW_MIN_PROBES`] probes and spanning at least [`WARM_WINDOW_MIN_SECONDS`]. `None`
931	/// while the series cannot yet satisfy both minimums.
932	///
933	/// - This window is both the exit condition's input and the stretch the reported warmup grade
934	///   is computed over ([`crate::report::env_stretches`]), so exiting on A and printing A are the same
935	///   computation.
936	fn warm_window(probes: &[ProbeSummary]) -> Option<&[ProbeSummary]> {
937	    if probes.len() < WARM_WINDOW_MIN_PROBES {
938	        return None;
939	    }
940	    let end_t = probes.last()?.t_start_s;
941	    let cut = end_t - WARM_WINDOW_MIN_SECONDS;
942	    // First probe at or past the span cutoff; the window must start strictly
943	    // before it to span the minimum.
944	    let past_cut = probes.partition_point(|p| p.t_start_s < cut);
945	    if past_cut == 0 {
946	        return None;
947	    }
948	    let start = (past_cut - 1).min(probes.len() - WARM_WINDOW_MIN_PROBES);

1110	            origin,
1111	            &mut probes,
1112	            &mut clock,
1113	            settle_time_s,
1114	        )
1115	    } else {
1116	        Vec::new()
1117	    };
1118	    let stretch_start = std::time::Instant::now();
1119	    let deadline = stretch_start + std::time::Duration::from_secs_f64(warm_cap_s);
1120	    let run_costs = warm_loop(
1121	        bench,
1122	        WarmPass::Adaptive {
1123	            min_steps: WARM_PASS_MIN_STEPS,
1124	            min_s: WARM_PASS_MIN_SECONDS,
1125	            deadline,
1126	        },
